created_for: EOG PR #699 minimum required relaxation exploratory real-source gate

source.title: Demography and environment modulate the effects of genetic diversity on extinction risk in a butterfly metapopulation

source_gate_scope: download one pinned version file exactly once with capped bytes
validate exact ZIP signatures and safe member paths; never extract
report archive SHA256 and selected member SHA256
report exact columns and data row count, year coverage, duplicated patch-year and DNA identities
check whether Patch x Year and DNA/ID are present and joinable across published source tables, report counts only
write deterministic machine-readable gate receipt and SHA256
forbidden: fit ecological, genetic, dispersal or prediction model
infer source or movement from non-detections or family ID alone
select favorable endpoint or tune thresholds from response
publish individual-level records or source archive in PR artifacts
field_bio_sufficiency: NOT_TESTED_PENDING_SOURCE_SCHEMA; origin, independent dispersal calibration and held-out chronology not established
transport_stop_rule: If HTTP access denied or ZIP/schema fails, archive STOP receipt and do not automatically retry or substitute another version.
existing_evidence_boundary: Entire exercise exploratory; 2019 and 2017 Glanville archives need not be fetched for this same-archive qualification.
